name: Platforms Directory

sources.title: Homepage — software/app directory across 30 categories, 'Registered Users 788'
Sign-in/listing page — OTP email login, 'up to 5 free product listings', moderated listings, paid boosts

requirements: Register a company/freelancer account first — 'List or Manage Product' links to signin.php
Sign-in is email + OTP (no password, no OAuth); Microsoft 365 addresses (Outlook/Hotmail) may fail OTP delivery — they recommend Gmail or non-Microsoft email
Check the product isn't already listed before registering; if it is, use claim-company.php to claim the existing listing
Free tier: up to 5 product listings; listings are moderated
Digital products only: software, web apps, extensions
preparation: A non-Microsoft email for reliable OTP delivery
Product name, URL, description, logo/screenshots, category, price type (Free/Freemium/Subscription/Perpetual/Paid/Tiered/Pay-As-You-Go)
workflow: Open https://platformsdirectory.com/signin.php and sign in with email OTP
From the dashboard, list the product (up to 5 free listings)
Listing enters moderation before going live
Optional paid upgrades: feature products at top, analytics, lead generation, more than 5 listings
watchFor: PHP/.php-era site (index.php, signin.php) with Mod_Security — plain curl gets 406 'Not Acceptable!'
OTP-only auth — no OAuth; corporate/Exchange inboxes may silently drop the OTP
Paid 'Boost' and lead-gen upgrades are the monetization — expect upsell prompts
countsAsLive: The product gets a public product.php?s=<slug> page in its category after moderation
unknowns: Pricing for boost/leads upgrades (not public on the pages fetched)
